title: Topic 2.2: Population distribution in Eastern Africa

pages.lesson:
LESSON: POPULATION DISTRIBUTION IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: PEOPLE, POPULATION AND SOCIAL ORGANISATIONS
Topic 2.2: Population distribution in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Population distribution in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why are some parts of Eastern Africa more populated than others?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa
2. explain effects of high population density in Eastern Africa

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. explain factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can explain factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain effects of high population density in Eastern Africa
   In simple words: practise until you can explain effects of high population density in Eastern Africa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Population distribution in Eastern Africa using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Population distribution in Eastern Africa in the examples.
2. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
4. Show that you can: explain factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Population distribution in Eastern Africa using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Population distribution in Eastern Africa important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Draw a map of Eastern Africa and locate areas of high and low population density using digital/print resources,
2. Discuss the effects of high population density in Eastern Africa and write a report,
3. Creativity and imagination: Learners share with parents and guardians about effects of population density in Eastern Africa
4. Social cohesion: Learners enhance tolerance and acceptance as they discuss, in groups, the effects of high population density in Eastern Africa. Values.
5. Unity: Learners strive to achieve common goals as they brainstorm, in pairs, on factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa and share in class.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain factors influencing population distribution in Eastern Africa
2. explain effects of high population density in Eastern Africa

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
